def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Each horizontal broken stripe joins corresponding vertical stripe of same color,
    # drawing the missing horizontal and vertical segment at their intersection.
    rows={}
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        vals=[(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(vals)>=2 and len({v for _,v in vals})==1:
            rows[r]=vals[0][1]
    cols={}
    for c in range(w):
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(h) if g[r][c]]
        if len(vals)>=2 and len(set(vals))==1:
            cols[c]=vals[0]
    for r,color in rows.items():
        for c,v in cols.items():
            if v==color:
                # close the horizontal line across its bounding span and vertical line
                # across the grid portion from stripe intersection to edge
                occupied=[c0 for c0,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x==color]
                lo,hi=min(occupied),max(occupied)
                for x in range(lo,hi+1): g[r][x]=color
                rr=[r0 for r0 in range(h) if g[r0][c]==color]
                # extend upward or downward from intersection to nearest grid edge
                if min(rr)>r: start,end=r,min(rr)
                elif max(rr)<r: start,end=max(rr),r
                else: start,end=0,r
                for y in range(start,end+1): g[y][c]=color
    return g
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Each horizontal bar has one or more single-cell breaks. Close the bars;
    # the vertical colored bars identify which break gets extended upward.
    bars=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(cols)>=4 and len({row[c] for c in cols})==1:
            color=row[cols[0]]
            bars.append((r,color,min(cols),max(cols),set(cols)))
            for c in range(min(cols),max(cols)+1):
                if row[c]==0: out[r][c]=color
    for r,color,lo,hi,cells in bars:
        for c in range(lo,hi+1):
            if c in cells: continue
            # A vertical continuation aligns through the bar's missing cell.
            # It extends upward from the gap, with intervening horizontal bars
            # contributing their own color at their crossings.
            intervening=[(rr,cc) for rr,cc,a,b,cs in bars if rr<r and a<=c<=b and c not in cs]
            if intervening:
                start=max(rr for rr,_ in intervening)+1
            else:
                start=0
            for rr in range(start,r):
                if out[rr][c]==0: out[rr][c]=color
    return out
